name: rosetta-poc-chat
description: Disposable streaming chat POC used for an independent Rosetta case study

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @rosetta-poc/chat-shared && npm run build -w @rosetta-poc/chat-api && npm run start -w @rosetta-poc/chat-api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @rosetta-poc/chat-shared && npm run dev -w @rosetta-poc/chat-web
